Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a complete white-out of the right hemithorax with a contralateral (leftward) mediastinal shift, which is the classic radiographic presentation of a massive pleural effusion pushing structures away. The appropriate next step in management is therapeutic and diagnostic thoracentesis to relieve the pressure and analyze the fluid.
